pr.title: feat(agents): audit + remediate custom agent fleet
pr.body:
## Summary
Fleet-wide audit and remediation of all custom agent surfaces per TP-DMX-AGENT-FLEET-0001.

- `.github/agents/` (6 Copilot agents): frontmatter compliance, model-field vendor verification, handoff integrity
- `.claude/personas/` (48): frontmatter normalization, least-privilege tools, stale-fleet-reference modernization (Task-Master/Zen-MCP/mem4sprint/o3/gemini-2.5 -> current fleet), deliberate consolidation with archive (no hard deletes), PERSONA_INDEX regenerated
- `.claude/agents/` (4 + index): rewritten to current fleet truth and proper subagent frontmatter
- `src/dopemux/personas/` (10): now a generated subset of canonical `.claude/personas/` via `scripts/sync_personas.py` with a byte-parity arch test
- `templates/skills/` (20): description/name/runner-variant consistency

Personal lane (~/.commandcode/agents, ~/.claude/agents) remediated separately, proof-recorded, excluded from this diff.

## Validation
See `proof/TP-DMX-AGENT-FLEET-0001/` — TP schema validation, frontmatter parse gate, stale-token grep gate, persona parity test, git diff --check, personas CLI smoke, embedded audit proof.

steps.task: Parse every agent file across all surfaces (repo agents, personas, curated agents, packaged personas, skill templates, personal lane). Record per-file verdicts (KEEP/FIX/ARCHIVE/MERGE) with file:line evidence in claudedocs/agent-fleet-audit-2026-07-30.md.
requirements: Every one of the ~137 files appears in the ledger with a verdict.
Stale tokens, over-privileged tool lists, missing frontmatter fields recorded with evidence.

steps.task: Bring .github/agents/dopemux-*.agent.md to full compliance with config/instructions/agents.instructions.md: verify or drop model fields, review target/infer, verify handoff targets resolve.
requirements: No unverifiable model ids remain.
All handoff agent targets exist after consolidation.
validation: python -c "import yaml,glob; [yaml.safe_load(open(f).read().split('---')[1]) for f in glob.glob('.github/agents/*.agent.md')]"

steps.task: Normalize frontmatter across .claude/personas/*.agent.md and *-dopemux.md (name, least-privilege tools, description); modernize stale fleet references (Task-Master, Zen-MCP, mem4sprint, o3/gemini-2.5 model names, Context7) to current fleet truth (task-orchestrator, PAL pal-mcp-server, ConPort, model-routing policy lanes); unverifiable claims become UNKNOWN.
requirements: Least privilege per agents.instructions.md tool aliases.
Zero stale tokens outside archive/ and the audit ledger.
No claim about MCP authority that mcp_catalog.yaml does not support.

steps.task: Resolve PERSONA_INDEX overlap groups; git mv archived personas to .claude/personas/archive/; verify instruction_manager alias table and repo-wide filename references before each move; regenerate PERSONA_INDEX.md to match reality.
requirements: No aliased persona stem breaks: dopemux personas list/show still resolves every alias.
PERSONA_INDEX.md counts and groupings match on-disk reality.

steps.task: Rewrite .claude/agents/{architect,developer,project-manager,researcher}.md to current fleet truth with proper subagent frontmatter (name/description/tools); fix _index.md counts and remove retired-service claims.
requirements: Each agent has name, description, tools frontmatter.
No references to Task-Master, Zen-MCP, mem4sprint, o3/gemini-2.5, Context7.

steps.task: Create scripts/sync_personas.py (canonical .claude/personas -> packaged src/dopemux/personas subset, fail-closed, --check mode) and tests/arch/test_persona_fleet_contract.py (byte-parity contract). Run sync.
requirements: Packaged files byte-identical to canonical after sync.
Parity test fails when drift is introduced.
sync_personas.py --check exits non-zero on drift, zero when in sync.

steps.task: templates/skills/*/SKILL.md: verify name matches directory, description has delegation triggers, runner-variant triplets (testgen-*, pr-docgen-sync-*) differ only in runner-specific sections.
requirements: Every SKILL.md name field equals its directory name.
Variant triplets are structurally consistent.
validation: for d in templates/skills/*/; do n=$(basename $d); grep -q "name: $n" $d/SKILL.md || echo MISMATCH $n; done; echo SKILL-CHECK-DONE

steps.task: Direct-edit ~/.commandcode/agents/*.md and ~/.claude/agents/*.md: add missing name fields, fix dopemux.md frontmatter, align rosters and formats per runtime. Proof-recorded; excluded from PR diff.
requirements: Every ~/.commandcode/agents file has name + description.
dopemux.md gains name: dopemux; opencode keys preserved (harmless passthrough).

steps.task: Run full gate: frontmatter YAML parse on all touched files, stale-token grep gate (zero hits outside archive/ + ledger), persona parity test, git diff --check, dopemux personas list/show smoke, pytest tests/arch -q.
requirements: All gates PASS with exit codes recorded for proof.

steps.task: codereview, embedded audit per AGENTS.md 9.1 (Claude Code Tier-1; PROOF.json + AUDITOR_REPORT.md + review_bundle under proof/TP-DMX-AGENT-FLEET-0001/, validated by scripts/audit/validate_audit_proof.py), precommit, commit slices, push, gh pr create, emit proof, remove worktree.
requirements: Embedded audit proof validates with exit 0.
PR diff touches only allowlisted paths.
Proof bundle per AGENTS.md section 9.
